rows.qualification: Master's degree (M-Tech/MS(R)/MCA/MPP or equivalent in Electrical Engineering, Power engineering, Energy Engineering, Energy Economics, Public Policy, or a closely related discipline, First Class or equivalent; Sound understanding of the Indian power sector - its planning, generation, transmission, distribution, and grid operations ecosystem - along with the regulatory framework governing it; Demonstrated research output in the form of papers, reports, or technical studies

PhD in Electrical Engineering, Public Policy, Economics / Finance, Energy Science, or related discipline [M-Tech in relevant field or Masters in Public Policy (MPP) with 4 years experience may also be considered]; Expertise in electricity markets, quantitative methods, modelling, and forecasting as applied to energy systems; policy framing; Sound understanding of the Indian power sector; Ability to draft research reports, discussion notes, working papers, and policy briefs
rows.experience: 4 years experience for candidates with M-Tech in relevant field or Masters in Public Policy (MPP)

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Master's degree (M-Tech/MS(R)/MCA/MPP or equivalent in Electrical Engineering, Power engineering, Energy Engineering, Energy Economics, Public Policy, or a closely related discipline, First Class or equivalent; Sound understanding of the Indian power sector - its planning, generation, transmission, distribution, and grid operations ecosystem - along with the regulatory framework governing it; Demonstrated research output in the form of papers, reports, or technical studies. Pay: Rs. 60,750 - 62,570 - 64,450 - 66,380 - 68,370 - 70,420 - 72,530 - 74,710 - 76,950 - 79,260 p.m. Plus HRA @30%. Qualification required: PhD in Electrical Engineering, Public Policy, Economics / Finance, Energy Science, or related discipline [M-Tech in relevant field or Masters in Public Policy (MPP) with 4 years experience may also be considered]; Expertise in electricity markets, quantitative methods, modelling, and forecasting as applied to energy systems; policy framing; Sound understanding of the Indian power sector; Ability to draft research reports, discussion notes, working papers, and policy briefs. Experience required: 4 years experience for candidates with M-Tech in relevant field or Masters in Public Policy (MPP). Pay: Rs. 75,600 - 77,870 - 80,210 - 82,620 - 85,100 - 87,650 - 90,280 - 92,900 - 95,780 - 98,650 - 1,01,610 p.m. plus HRA @30%.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: For a retired/superannuated government employee who is selected, salary will be fixed as per prevailing IRD norms. Appointment on contractual basis with consolidated pay Renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier Project duration up to 27/05/2030
